I'll search for information about wakehealth.edu to help answer your question.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>wakehealth.edu Wake Forest Baptist Health</query>

Based on my search, **wakehealth.edu** is the official website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical center and health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here are the key details:

## Overview

- **Formerly known as**: Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center and Wake Forest Baptist Health
- **Affiliation**: Part of **Atrium Health**, one of the largest healthcare systems in the United States, following a strategic combination in 2020
- **Academic affiliation**: The clinical enterprise of **Wake Forest School of Medicine**, which is part of Wake Forest University

## Key Components

| Feature | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Flagship hospital** | Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Hospital (885+ beds) |
| **Level I Trauma Center** | Yes – serves the region |
| **NCI-Designated Comprehensive Cancer Center** | Yes – one of only about 50 in the U.S. |
| **Research focus** | Significant emphasis on biomedical research |
| **Medical education** | Training programs for medical students, residents, and fellows |

## Services & Locations

The health system includes:
- The main academic medical center in Winston-Salem
- Multiple community hospitals
- Urgent care and outpatient facilities
- Physician practices throughout North Carolina and surrounding regions

## Notable Distinctions

- Home to **Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine** – a world leader in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine research
- Pioneer in various medical fields including cancer treatment, neuroscience, and cardiovascular care
